title: Autism Detection in Speech – A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing and extracting male-to-female participant ratios across existing clinical and NLP datasets to demonstrate the severe under-representation of autistic females in speech and language research.

Surveying the performance of large contextualized language models on neuroatypical (ASD) versus neurotypical (NT) language to highlight performance disparities stemming from training data biased toward typical speech patterns.
